final: WITH kept AS (SELECT * FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL) AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL)), g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(TAT - TAT2) AS avg_diff FROM kept GROUP BY ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt), AVG(avg_diff) FROM g
